Acid Absorption.name: Acid Absorption
Acid Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within acidic environments. Its Acid resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Acid Spit.name: Acid Spit
Acid Spit.description: The creature has salivary glands which produce a caustic acid.

acidSpit.name: Acid Spit
acidSpit.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits a glob of acidic bile at a target within 20 feet.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, this attack causes the @Condition[corroding] condition for 3 Turns.

Acid Spray.name: Acid Spray
Acid Spray.description: The creature has salivary glands which produce a caustic acidic spray.

acidSpray.name: Acid Spray
acidSpray.description:
The creature expels a spray of acidic bile in a 10 foot fan.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, this attack causes the @Condition[corroding] condition for 3 Turns.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its @Rule[movement.stride]. It gains a bonus to @Rule[defense.dodge] equal to half its @Rule[ability.toughness] score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.

Aqueous Camouflage.name: Aqueous Camouflage
Aqueous Camouflage.description: While fully submerged in water or liquids, @ref[actor.name]{this creature} has @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} on @Rule[skill.stealth] checks.

Aqueous Transmission.name: Aqueous Transmission
Aqueous Transmission.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to move instantaneously through water.

aqueousTransmission.name: Aqueous Transmission
aqueousTransmission.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is within water, it can instantaneously transport itself to any unoccupied space within the same body of water up to 120 feet away. It does not need to be able to see the destination to make this Move.

Bestial Senses.name: Bestial Senses
Bestial Senses.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has finely honed senses and is particularly perceptive of their environment, all @Rule[skill.awareness] checks gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons}.

Blindsight.name: Blindsight
Blindsight.description: @ref[actor.name]{This creature} perceives its surroundings without the use of sight, sensing the precise location of creatures and objects within 60 feet. It is unaffected by @Condition[blinded], darkness, or invisibility, and any creature it detects this way is treated as visible to it.

Blood Sense.name: Blood Sense
Blood Sense.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can precisely sense any blooded creature within 20 feet which does not have all its hit points. Any weapon or skill attack against a wounded creature does not suffer @Rule[dice.bane]{Banes} that would normally apply if the creature were @Condition[blinded].

Bloodless.name: Bloodless
Bloodless.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has no blood, vital organs, or exploitable weak points. It is immune to the @Condition[bleeding] condition, and the @Rule[dice.criticalSuccessThreshold] for Strikes against it is increased by 2.

Bonded Mind.name: Bonded Mind
Bonded Mind.description: The mind of a @ref[actor.name]{creature} with this talent is inextricably bound to other members of its group. It is capable of instantaneous telepathic communication with any other @ref[actor.taxonomy.name]{creature of its taxonomy} within 60 feet.

Buck.name: Buck
Buck.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} lowers its head towards the ground and lashes out with its hind legs with explosive force.

buck.name: Buck
buck.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} makes two @Rule[action.natural]{Natural} attacks with its hooves against a single target that is behind it. The strike is @Rule[action.difficult] and deals bludgeoning damage if it hits.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] the target is knocked @Condition[prone].

Burnout.name: Burnout
Burnout.description: Steam-powered constructs store dangerous amounts of superheated steam within their bodies that, if not discharged safely, can cause serious injury.

steamVent.name: Burnout
steamVent.description: The @ref[actor.name]{construct} ruptures, spilling forth a blast of flame and smoke, attacking the @Rule[defense.reflex] of each target within the radius and dealing Fire damage. Those who take damage from this attack are @Condition[blinded] for 3 turns.

Burrower.name: Burrower
Burrower.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has a supernatural ability to rapidly burrow through solid surfaces which are not entirely impermeable.

Additionally, it can compress its body to pass through apertures that can accommodate ¼ of its @Rule[movement.size].

explosiveEmergence.name: Explosive Emergence
explosiveEmergence.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} emerges from a subterranean position with surprising and sudden force. This action may only be activated immediately the creature leaves the @Condition[burrowing] state.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} erupts to Strike against all enemies within its weapon range with an @Rule[action.empowered] attack.

submergingWithdrawal.name: Submerging Withdrawal
submergingWithdrawal.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} retracts beneath the surface using a Burrow movement, relocating away from its current position. Ending this movement underground grants the @Condition[burrowing] condition, beneath which it cannot be seen by light-based perception.

This action cannot be used while @Condition[staggered], @Condition[stunned], @Condition[slowed], or @Condition[paralyzed].

Clinging Grip.name: Clinging Grip
Clinging Grip.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to cling to vertical or overhead surfaces with exceptional grip or adhesion. This creature can avoid falling as long as they are adjacent to any solid surface which can reasonably support them.

droppingStrike.name: Dropping Strike
droppingStrike.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can drop from overhead to Strike a creature below it. The target creature suffers an @Rule[action.empowered] attack which, if successful, knocks them @Condition[prone] in addition to dealing damage.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can suffer falling damage from this attack only if it misses its target.

Cold Absorption.name: Cold Absorption
Cold Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within frigid environments. Its Cold resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Corrosive Strikes.name: Corrosive Strikes
Corrosive Strikes.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature}'s caustic body sears whatever it strikes. When it scores a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} with a melee attack that deals damage to @Rule[resource.health], the target becomes @Condition[corroding] for 3 Rounds.

Corrupting Death Burst.name: Corrupting Death Burst
Corrupting Death Burst.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} dies, it explodes in a volatile burst of corrupting energy.

corruptingDeathBurst.name: Corrupting Death Burst
corruptingDeathBurst.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} becomes @Condition[dead], it explodes in a pulse of spores that deal Corruption damage, attacking the @Rule[defense.fortitude] defense of all nearby creatures that fail to resist the effect and upon critical success afflicting them with the @Condition[decaying] condition for 3 rounds.

Corruption Absorption.name: Corruption Absorption
Corruption Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to shrug off the effects of Death magic. Its Corruption resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Crushing Leap.name: Crushing Leap
Crushing Leap.description: This creature hurls its bulk into the air and crashes down upon its foes with tremendous, ground-shaking force.

crushingLeap.name: Crushing Leap
crushingLeap.description: You leap into the air, landing at a point you can see within 30 feet and crashing down with crushing force. All creatures within the area of the resulting Blast face an attack against their @Rule[defense.reflex], suffering Bludgeoning damage and are knocked @Condition[prone]. The Blast extends outward from your own footprint, so larger creatures crash down over a wider area. This action scales with your highest ability of @Rule[ability.strength] or @Rule[ability.toughness].

Darkvision.name: Darkvision
Darkvision.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can see in darkness as though it were dim light up to 60 feet away, perceiving its surroundings in shades of grey. Darkvision does not function while the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is @Condition[blinded].

Dying Call.name: Dying Call
Dying Call.description: When @ref[actor.name]{this creature} is in the throes of death, it emits one last call, alerting others nearby that it has been killed and calling for vengeance.

dyingCall.name: Dying Call
dyingCall.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} emits a shrill call as a dying act, notifying similar nearby creatures of its death, which are instinctually drawn towards this location.

Echolocation.name: Echolocation
Echolocation.description:
@ref[actor.name]{This creature} perceives the world through the emission of sonic pulses that detect shapes with precision, allowing it to locate creatures that are moving or otherwise emitting sound, up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover. If the creature is @Condition[deafened], this sense may not be used.

A creature detected using @ref[name] is treated as visible for the purposes of actions which require you to see your target.

Electricity Absorption.name: Electricity Absorption
Electricity Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to take lightning blasts in stride. Its Electricity resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Elusive Flight.name: Elusive Flight
Elusive Flight.description: This @ref[actor.name]{creature} is especially elusive while in flight, able to swoop in and out of combat without provoking any @Action[default reactiveStrike]. It can be @Rule[movement.engagement]{engaged} if it lands upon the ground and such strikes may be used if it attempts to return to flight.

Ensnare.name: Ensnare
Ensnare.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} lashes out with a grasping tendril, coil, or limb to seize prey at range and drag it into a crushing hold.

ensnare.name: Ensnare
ensnare.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} reaches out to seize a single target within range, attacking its @Rule[defense.reflex]. On a success the target is dragged back into reach and becomes @Condition[restrained]. This action may only be used on creatures which are eligible targets for @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.grapple000000000 grapple].

The hold is maintained until the @ref[actor.name]{creature} releases it, the target escapes, or a different creature is targeted with Ensnare.

Extended Breath.name: Extended Breath
Extended Breath.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Fire Absorption.name: Fire Absorption
Fire Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within scorching environments. Its Fire resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Glider.name: Glider
Glider.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} controls its descent while falling. Unless it is @Condition[incapacitated] or @Condition[restrained], a fall becomes a Glide: a downward Fly movement instead of an impact, suffering no falling damage.

While gliding the creature's @Rule[movement.stride] is doubled and it is granted a @Rule[movement.freeMovement]{free move}, so it can always glide at least a short distance. Its glide must descend, and wherever the movement ends is where it comes to rest; if it ends the glide still aloft it gains the @Condition[flying] condition.

fallGlide.name: Glide
fallGlide.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} glides rather than falls, flying downward under control. The movement must descend and suffers no falling damage. If the creature ends its glide while still aloft it gains the @Condition[flying] condition.

Gloom Sight.name: Gloom Sight
Gloom Sight.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can gaze into the gloom of total darkness and see normally. Magical darkness does not impede the creature's vision.

System Development: This feature needs automation to configure vision and detection modes that are unaffected by magical darkness.

Glowing Body.name: Glowing Body
Glowing Body.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} emits non-magical bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light in a 30 foot radius.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} slams its antlers, tusks, or horns into a creature with its full might.

gore.name: Gore
gore.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} slams its antlers, tusks, or horns into a creature with its @Rule[action.brute] strength, making a@Rule[action.deadly] attack which, if successful also renders its target @Condition[staggered] until the end of their next Turn.

Grave Mark.name: Grave Mark
Grave Mark.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} achieves a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} with a melee attack, it leaves a baleful Grave Mark upon its target.

graveMark.name: Grave Mark
graveMark.description:
After achieving a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} with a melee attack, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks the target's @Rule[defense.willpower] defense, leaving a Grave Mark upon a success that inflicts the @Condition[exhausted] condition, which persists until the target completes a @Action[default rest].

If a humanoid creature bearing a Grave Mark dies while under the effects of the mark, it rises from death on its subsequent Turn as a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.taxonomy.Item.ghoul00000000000]{Ghoul}.
graveMark.condition: When achieving a Critical Hit with a melee attack.

Horrific Critical.name: Horrific Critical
Horrific Critical.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} delivers savage and grotesque blows that evoke fear within any who behold them.

horrificCritical.name: Horrific Critical
horrificCritical.description:
When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} achieves a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} using a melee attack it may exaggerate the blow in a way that evokes fear within those who behold the strike.

All the enemies within 30 feet who can see the creature face a @Rule[action.harmless] attack against their @Rule[defense.willpower] or become @Condition[frightened] for 3 Turns.
horrificCritical.condition: Immediately after the creature achieves a Critical Hit with a melee attack.

Immutable Form.name: Immutable Form
Immutable Form.description: The @ref[actor.name] is immune to any spell or effect which alters its physical form.

Lightning Burst.name: Lightning Burst
Lightning Burst.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to produce and expel powerful voltaic blast.

lightningBurst.name: Lightning Burst
lightningBurst.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} expels a blast of lighting in a 15 foot blast, attacking the @Rule[defense.reflex] of each target within that range and and dealing Electricity damage.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} the attack causes the @Condition[shocked] condition for 3 Turns.

Lightning Spit.name: Lightning Spit
Lightning Spit.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to produce and expel minor voltaic discharge.

lightningSpit.name: Lightning Spit
lightningSpit.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits a small bolt of lightning at a target creature within 20 feet, attacking its @Rule[defense.reflex] and dealing Electricity damage.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} the attack causes the @Condition[shocked] condition for 3 Turns.

Lightning Spray.name: Lightning Spray
Lightning Spray.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to produce and expel powerful voltaic discharge.

lightningSpray.name: Lightning Spray
lightningSpray.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} expels a bolt of lighting in a 30 foot ray that is 4 feet wide, attacking the @Rule[defense.reflex] of each target along that path and dealing Electricity damage.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} the attack causes the @Condition[shocked] condition for 3 Turns.

Living Boulder.name: Living Boulder
Living Boulder.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} channels earth through its own physical mass rather than its mind. Its usage of the Rune of Earth scales with @Rule[ability.toughness] instead of @Rule[ability.wisdom].

Maddening Shriek.name: Maddening Shriek
Maddening Shriek.description: This @ref[actor.name]{creature} is capable of emitting a piercing screech so shrill that it can cause temporary hearing loss in other creatures who perceive it.

maddeningShriek.name: Maddening Shriek
maddeningShriek.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} emits a shrill and piercing screech, attacking the @Rule[resource.morale] of all those contained within and afflicting them with the @Condition[deafened] condition for one round.

Natural Invisibility.name: Natural Invisibility
Natural Invisibility.description: By some organic or arcane aspect of its physiology, @ref[actor.name]{this creature] possesses the ability to become completely invisible.

invisibility.name: Natural Invisibility
invisibility.description: You become @Condition[invisible] and cannot be detected using sight-based perception. You cannot be directly targeted by any action. This effect remains active for 10 minutes or until any non-Movement action is taken.

Necrotic Bite.name: Necrotic Bite
Necrotic Bite.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} tears into flesh with a maw that is corrupted by pestilence and undeath.

necroticBite.name: Necrotic Bite
necroticBite.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks with a pestilent bite that is @Rule[action.empowered] and deals Corruption damage.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] the attack causes the @Condition[decaying] condition for 3 Turns.

Noxious Spit.name: Noxious Spit
Noxious Spit.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} produces a salivary toxin that it can expel in a projected globule.

noxiousSpit.name: Noxious Spit
noxiousSpit.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits globule of toxin at a target creature within 20 feet, attacking its @Rule[defense.reflex] and dealing Poison damage.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} the attack causes the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 3 Turns.

Noxious Spray.name: Noxious Spray
Noxious Spray.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to produce and expel toxic discharge in a projected ray.

noxiousSpray.name: Noxious Spray
noxiousSpray.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} expels toxic discharge in a 30 foot ray that is 4 feet wide, attacking the @Rule[defense.reflex] of each target along that path and dealing Poison damage.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} the attack causes the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 3 Turns.

Corrode Weapon.name: Corrode Weapon
Corrode Weapon.description: The internal corrosive metabolism of the @ref[actor.name]{ooze} threatens to dissolve metal weapons that strike it.

oozeCorrodeWeapon.name: Corrode Weapon
oozeCorrodeWeapon.description:
When struck by a melee weapon made of metal, the ooze attempts to consume the weapon itself, potentially breaking it.

This attack is @Rule[action.harmless], but if successful the Quality of the weapon used in the attack is downgraded by one tier. On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] or if the weapon is already Shoddy, the weapon becomes entirely Broken. Enchanted weapons are protected against this effect.
oozeCorrodeWeapon.condition: Struck in melee by a weapon made of metal.

Multiply.name: Multiply
Multiply.description: The @ref[actor.name]{ooze} grows rapidly, increasing in health and size.

oozeMultiply.name: Multiply
oozeMultiply.description: The ooze's cells rapidly multiply as the creature grows. Its @Rule[movement.size] increases by 1 and its @Rule[resource.health] increases by its @Rule[ability.toughness] value.

Subdivide.name: Subdivide
Subdivide.description: The @ref[actor.name]{ooze} can divide itself into multiple parts, each an independent copy of the original.

oozeSubdivide.name: Subdivide
oozeSubdivide.description: The ooze's cells rapidly divide and the creature splits in two! The original creature and its clone equally divide its remaining @Rule[resource.health]. The @Rule[movement.size] of each resulting creature is decreased by 1, and its threat tier is reduced, for example an Elite ooze becomes a Normal ooze. The new ooze arrives with only the @Rule[resource.action] and @Rule[resource.focus] its parent had remaining after performing this Action. If in combat, the new creature acts as a Summon and joins at Initiative 1. This Action may only be used if the creature has @Rule[movement.size] larger than 2.

Pack Hunter.name: Pack Hunter
Pack Hunter.description:
This creature is a pack hunter, relying on its allies to flank and harrass a target to render it exposed to further harm.

This creature doubles number of @Rule[dice.boon]{Boons} awarded from attacking a @Condition[flanked] enemy.

Polybrachial.name: Polybrachial
Polybrachial.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has a multitude of arms that it can use to perform actions. It always counts as having two free hands for spellcraft or interaction no matter what items it has equipped.

Pouncing Strike.name: Pouncing Strike
Pouncing Strike.description: This creature lunges forward, putting its whole weight behind a leaping strike.

pouncingStrike.name: Pouncing Strike
pouncingStrike.description:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Psychic Absorption.name: Psychic Absorption
Psychic Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is exceptionally unyielding to attacks on its mind. Its Psychic resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Radiant Absorption.name: Radiant Absorption
Radiant Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is no stranger to the chaotic force of light. Its Radiant resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Radiant Death Burst.name: Radiant Death Burst
Radiant Death Burst.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} dies, it explodes in a volatile burst of radiant energy.

radiantDeathBurst.name: Radiant Death Burst
radiantDeathBurst.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} becomes @Condition[dead], it explodes in a pulse of Radiant energy which attacks the @Rule[defense.fortitude] defense of all nearby creatures that fail to resist the effect and upon critical success afflicting them with the @Condition[irradiated] condition for 3 rounds.

Rake.name: Rake
Rake.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks rapidly with its talons, dealing multiple raking blows against a single target.

rake.name: Rake
rake.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks swiftly with claws or talons.

If at least one attack results in a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess], it inflicts the @Condition[bleeding] condition for 2 Rounds.

Repugnant Pustules.name: Repugnant Pustules
Repugnant Pustules.description: A malodorous cloud hangs about this creature like a pall, the rank noxious scent that can only come from active decay. Striking this creature is likely to release repugnant and corrupting essence.

repugnantPustules.name: Repugnant Pustules
repugnantPustules.description:
When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is hit by a Strike, it may partially burst to release a spray of sickening fluid that deals Corruption damage. This action scales with @Rule[ability.toughness] and targets the @Rule[defense.reflex] defense of any creature within 3 feet.

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess], the affected target becomes temporarily @Condition[diseased] for 3 Rounds.

Restless Dead.name: Restless Dead
Restless Dead.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature}'s life is sustained by necromantic magic or otherworldly forces. When it would be considered @Condition[dead] it is instead @Condition[incapacitated].

After the conclusion of combat, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} may begin to perform the Recover action, regaining consciousness after the recovery is complete. Recovery in this fashion may be prevented in one of the following ways:

  • The creature was incapacitated by a type of damage for which it is Vulnerable.

  • The magical forces which caused it to rise as undead are disrupted, countered, or otherwise dispelled.

  • The creature's body is destroyed to a degree that it can no longer maintain its physical form.

Restraining Chomp.name: Restraining Chomp
Restraining Chomp.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} uses its powerful jaws to bite and hold a target with a powerful chomp.

restrainingChomp.name: Restraining Chomp
restrainingChomp.description: The creature chomps down upon its target. If the attack is successful and the target is equal or lesser in @Rule[movement.size], the target is also @Condition[restrained] until this creature chooses to release it or the restraint is otherwise broken. Only one target may be restrained by this action at a given time.

Sacrifice Self.name: Sacrifice Self
Sacrifice Self.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may intervene to take a blow instead of an adjacent ally.

sacrificeSelf.name: Sacrifice Self
sacrificeSelf.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} reacts, performing a Movement up to their @Rule[movement.stride] to interpose itself between a nearby ally and some source of harm which it can perceive.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} becomes @Condition[dead], destroyed in their sacrifice, but the triggering action causes no effects to its original target.
sacrificeSelf.condition: A nearby ally is targeted by a hostile action.

Self-Repair.name: Self-Repair
Self-Repair.description: The @ref[actor.name]{construct} activates internal repairing mechanisms to mitigate damage it has taken.

selfRepair.name: Self-Repair
selfRepair.description: The construct recovers its @Rule[ability.toughness] value in @Rule[resource.health] and immediately ends a single status condition of its choice that is currently affecting it.

Servitor.name: Servitor
Servitor.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} serves the will of another and maintains a connection to that master that allows the transmission or messages or even the sharing of senses between the servitor and its controller.

servitorSending.name: Servitor Sending
servitorSending.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can contact its master, sending inaudible communication which is instantaneously received by its controller as long as that other creature is capable of receiving messages.

Shadow Gait.name: Shadow Gait
Shadow Gait.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to step into and out of shadow itself to move in nightmarish and unpredictable ways.

shadowGait.name: Shadow Gait
shadowGait.description: While in dim light or darkness, the @ref[actor.name] can meld into shadow to disappear from view. It may Move and reappear within a different area which is also dim light or darkness. This is a Displace movement which provokes no disengagement.

Slippery Form.name: Slippery Form
Slippery Form.description: This creature is permanently slippery, giving it the ability to elude capture by physical restraints.

slipperyEscape.name: Slippery Escape
slipperyEscape.description: The creature uses it slippery form to escape restraints, immediately ending the @Condition[restrained] condition.

Steam Vent.name: Steam Vent
Steam Vent.description: Steam-powered constructs store dangerous amounts of superheated steam within their bodies that, if not discharged safely, can cause serious injury.

steamVent.name: Steam Vent
steamVent.description: Superheated steam bursts forth from inside the steam-powered construct in a burst of searing damage, knocking back those standing too close and leaving them @Condition[prone] .

Sunlight Weakness.name: Sunlight Weakness
Sunlight Weakness.description:
While in sunlight, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} suffers @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes} to all actions.

This mechanic is handled through an Active Effect that is easily toggled when applicable.

Sunlight Weakness.name: Sunlight Weakness
Sunlight Weakness.description: The creature suffers banes to all actions when exposed to sunlight.

Swallow.name: Swallow
Swallow.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can swallow whole a creature whose @Rule[movement.size] is at least 2 less than its own. Only one creature may be swallowed at a time, unless an additional creature is one-quarter of this creature's @Rule[movement.size] or less.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.description:
You swallow a target enemy, effectively removing that foe from combat. The swallowed target is @Condition[blinded] and @Condition[restrained] until released.

If you become @Condition[stunned], @Condition[incapacitated], or @Condition[weakened], you regurgitate every swallowed creature.

regurgitate.name: Regurgitate
regurgitate.description: You expel every creature you have swallowed, returning them to the space around you and ending the @Condition[blinded] and @Condition[restrained] conditions imposed by your gullet.

Swarm.name: Swarm
Swarm.description:
This adversary is a group of many identical creatures that operate as a single swarming throng of foes.

  • Maximum @Rule[resource.health] is doubled.

  • Against any single-target source of damage, the swarm gains additional Resistance equal to its @Rule[ability.toughness].

  • The swarm's @Rule[movement.size] decreases as its @Rule[resource.health] is depleted until reaching a minimum @Rule[movement.size] of 2.

Swooping Strike.name: Swooping Strike
Swooping Strike.description: This @ref[actor.name]{creature} swoops from high above into a diving attack.

swoopingStrike.name: Swooping Strike
swoopingStrike.description:
This attack may be used after a Move which descended at least 10 feet towards the target. The attack gains @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Tail Sweep.name: Tail Sweep
Tail Sweep.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can whip its heavy tail across the battlefield with terrible force.

tailSweep.name: Tail Sweep
tailSweep.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} sweeps its heavy tail in a circular arc, striking all creatures within range. On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess], affected targets become @Condition[staggered] until the end of their next turn.

Terrifying Presence.name: Terrifying Presence
Terrifying Presence.description: Something about the presence of this creature motivates a pure and unbridled fear in those who observe it.

terrifyingPresence.name: Terrifying Presence
terrifyingPresence.description: When an enemy moves within 20 feet of the @ref[actor.name]{creature}, it becomes exposed to the dreadful presence, attacking its @Rule[defense.willpower] and inflicting the @Condition[frightened] condition upon success.

Thermal Vision.name: Thermal Vision
Thermal Vision.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} perceives the world through differences in temperature with precision, allowing it to locate creatures whose bodily temperature deviates from ambient norms.

This allows detection of creatures whose body temperatures are Gelid, Cool, Warm, or Boiling up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover and as long as the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is not @Condition[blinded] or @Condition[incapacitated]. A creature detected in this way is treated as visible for the purposes of Actions which require sight.

Thrash.name: Thrash
Thrash.description: Once the @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an enemy restrained, it will thrash violently dealing terrible blows to the grasped victim.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.description: The creature deals @Rule[action.deadly] damage to a target that it currently has @Condition[restrained].
thrash.condition: The target is Restrained by this creature.

Trampling Charge.name: Trampling Charge
Trampling Charge.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} uses its prodigious size to charge forward, trampling smaller creatures that stand in its way.

tramplingCharge.name: Trampling Charge
tramplingCharge.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} moves forward up to twice its @Rule[movement.stride], attacking the @Rule[defense.reflex] defense of all creatures in its path. Targets who are half the creature's size or smaller are @Condition[stunned] until the end of their next turn as they are slammed aside.

This action uses the lowest-cost natural weapon the creature has equipped, preferring one that deals Bludgeoning damage.

Tusk Charge.name: Tusk Charge
Tusk Charge.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} lowers its head and charges with frantic speed, it's tusks protruding from beneath a drooling gullet.

tuskCharge.name: Tusk Charge
tuskCharge.description: Charge in a direct line up to your @Rule[movement.stride] and make a Strike against the first creature you encounter. If successful, the target is knocked @Condition[prone].

Magical Sight.name: Magical Sight
Magical Sight.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has otherworldly sight that makes it especially aware of dangers or opportunities. It gains @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to any @Rule[skill.awareness] check and can see @Condition[invisible] creatures.

venomousBite.name: Venomous Bite
venomousBite.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks, injects toxin which, if successful, inflicts the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 6 Turns.

Void Absorption.name: Void Absorption
Void Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is no stranger to the orderly force of darkness. Its Void resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Web Spinner.name: Web Spinner
Web Spinner.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can create powerfully adhesive webbing. It ignores any movement restrictions or restraints otherwise caused by webbing.

While in contact with a web, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} knows the precise location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

webSpinner.name: Web Spinner
webSpinner.description: The creature can spend 10 minutes to spin a new new section of webbing that covers a 5-foot area.
